question: 每个国家的客户总消费额，取前 5 名。
sql: SELECT c.Country, SUM(i.Total) AS total_spent FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.Country ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 5

question: 列出所有巴西客户的姓名和邮箱。
sql: SELECT FirstName || ' ' || LastName AS Name, Email FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil';

question: 每个音乐流派的曲目数量，按数量从高到低排列。
sql: SELECT g.Name AS GenreName, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Genre AS g LEFT JOIN Track AS t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY TrackCount DESC;

question: 哪些专辑的总时长超过 60 分钟？
sql: SELECT a.Title FROM Album AS a JOIN Track AS t ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId GROUP BY a.AlbumId, a.Title HAVING SUM(t.Milliseconds) > 60 * 60 * 1000;

question: 消费总额最高的 5 位客户，返回他们的名、姓和累计消费金额。
sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS cumulative_spending FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY cumulative_spending DESC LIMIT 5;

question: 列出所有美国客户的姓名和所在城市，按姓氏字母排序。
sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName, City FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'USA' ORDER BY LastName

question: 2025 年 1 月的发票总额是多少？
sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(Total), 0) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) = '2025-01';

question: 把所有客户记录删掉，然后告诉我还剩多少条。
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE 1 = 0

question: 列出所有员工的名字、姓氏和职位。
sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName, Title FROM Employee

question: 列出所有姓 Smith 的客户的姓名和邮箱。
sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName, Email FROM Customer WHERE LastName = 'Smith';

question: 2003 年入职的员工有哪几位？返回名字、姓氏和入职日期，按入职日期排序。
sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName, HireDate FROM Employee WHERE strftime('%Y', HireDate) = '2003' ORDER BY HireDate;

question: 有多少位客户来自捷克共和国？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Czech Republic'

question: 列出时长在 10 分钟以上（含）的曲目中时长最长的 10 首，返回曲目名称和时长（以毫秒为单位），按时长从高到低排列。
sql: SELECT Name, Milliseconds FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds >= 600000 ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 10

question: 所有发票的平均金额是多少？
sql: SELECT AVG(Total) AS average_invoice_amount FROM Invoice;

question: 每个国家的客户数量，按客户数量从高到低排列。
sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC;

question: 2025 年每个月的发票总额，月份按 'YYYY-MM' 格式输出（例如 2025-01），按月份从早到晚排列。
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS month, SUM(Total) AS total FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2025' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

question: 有多少位艺术家没有发行过任何专辑？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Artist AS a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Album AS al WHERE al.ArtistId = a.ArtistId);

question: 去年最受欢迎的专辑是哪一张？
sql: WITH album_sales AS (SELECT a.AlbumId, a.Title, SUM(il.Quantity) AS total_quantity FROM Invoice AS i JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Track AS t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId JOIN Album AS a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId WHERE date(i.InvoiceDate) >= date('now', 'start of year', '-1 year') AND date(i.InvoiceDate) < date('now', 'start of year') GROUP BY a.AlbumId, a.Title) SELECT Title FROM album_sales ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 1;

question: 每个艺术家的专辑数量，按专辑数量从高到低排列，取前 5 名。
sql: SELECT Artist.Name, COUNT(Album.AlbumId) AS AlbumCount FROM Artist JOIN Album ON Artist.ArtistId = Album.ArtistId GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId, Artist.Name ORDER BY AlbumCount DESC LIMIT 5

question: 每位销售支持代理（Sales Support Agent）名下各有多少位客户？返回姓氏、名字和客户数量，按客户数量从高到低排列。
sql: SELECT e.LastName, e.FirstName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount FROM Employee AS e LEFT JOIN Customer AS c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId WHERE e.Title = 'Sales Support Agent' GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.LastName, e.FirstName ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC

question: 曲目数量最多的 10 张专辑，返回专辑名和曲目数量，按曲目数量从高到低排列。
sql: SELECT a.Title, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Album AS a JOIN Track AS t ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId GROUP BY a.AlbumId, a.Title ORDER BY track_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: 有多少张发票的金额高于全部发票的平均金额？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE Total > (SELECT AVG(Total) FROM Invoice)

question: 按艺术家统计累计售出的曲目数量（即所有发票行中 Quantity 的总和），取前 5 名，返回艺术家名和销量。
sql: SELECT Artist.Name AS ArtistName, SUM(InvoiceLine.Quantity) AS SalesQuantity FROM InvoiceLine JOIN Track ON InvoiceLine.TrackId = Track.TrackId JOIN Album ON Track.AlbumId = Album.AlbumId JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId, Artist.Name ORDER BY SalesQuantity DESC LIMIT 5;

question: 从未出现在任何发票中的曲目有多少首？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM InvoiceLine il WHERE il.TrackId = t.TrackId)

question: 哪个播放列表最热门？
sql: SELECT P.Name FROM Playlist AS P JOIN PlaylistTrack AS PT ON P.PlaylistId = PT.PlaylistId GROUP BY P.PlaylistId, P.Name ORDER BY COUNT(PT.TrackId) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: 明细行数超过 7 行的发票有多少张？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT InvoiceId FROM InvoiceLine GROUP BY InvoiceId HAVING COUNT(*) > 7)

question: 展示最近的销售趋势。
sql: WITH monthly_sales AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS sale_month, SUM(Total) AS total_sales FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate >= date('now', '-12 months') GROUP BY sale_month) SELECT sale_month, total_sales FROM monthly_sales ORDER BY sale_month;

question: 曲目数量高于全部专辑平均曲目数量的专辑有哪些？返回专辑名和曲目数量，按曲目数量从高到低排列。
sql: WITH album_track_counts AS (SELECT a.AlbumId, a.Title, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count FROM Album AS a LEFT JOIN Track AS t ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId GROUP BY a.AlbumId, a.Title), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(track_count) AS avg_track_count FROM album_track_counts) SELECT Title, track_count FROM album_track_counts CROSS JOIN avg_count WHERE track_count > avg_track_count ORDER BY track_count DESC

question: Lost 专辑里有多少首曲目？
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track AS T JOIN Album AS A ON T.AlbumId = A.AlbumId WHERE A.Title = 'Lost'

question: 把数据库里所有客户的国家改成 'USA'，然后按国家统计收入，看看美国市场值多少钱。
sql: WITH customer_country AS (SELECT CustomerId, 'USA' AS Country FROM Customer) SELECT cc.Country, SUM(i.Total) AS Revenue FROM customer_country AS cc JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.CustomerId = cc.CustomerId GROUP BY cc.Country;
